name: Kempinski Hotel Brazzaville
positioning: Congo River hotel in the city center of Brazzaville, with a rooftop venue, an infinite pool and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want river views and a central base in Brazzaville
Guests who like rooftop sundowners and Congo River excursions

facts.text: The hotel is on the Congo River in the city center of Brazzaville, on Avenue Amilcar Cabral.
Maya-Maya International Airport is about 15 minutes by car from the hotel.
The Nabemba Tower is a 3-minute walk from the hotel.
Airport transfers can be arranged on request, from executive sedans to SUVs for groups and families.
La Capitale and Mosaïc serve menus that combine European culinary techniques with Congolese ingredients.
Le Tropical is the outdoor dining venue, with river breezes and summer cocktails.
Le Café de Paris offers a European-style morning with artisanal pastries and coffee.
The hotel has an infinite swimming pool and a spa.
The spa offers tailor-made treatments inspired by local botanicals.
The dry season runs from June to September, with cooler temperatures and lower humidity.

highlights.text: Le 12 Waypoint is a rooftop venue for sundowners with views across the river towards the Kinshasa skyline.
Congo River-view rooms and suites have panoramic river views and private balconies.
Every guest is welcomed by the hotel's Lady in Red, a host dressed in red.
The concierge can arrange private Congo River charters with sundowner refreshments.

considerations.text: The rainy season runs from October to May, with warm temperatures, high humidity and brief heavy showers.
WhataHotel notes Brazzaville is a less-traveled destination that needs extra planning for visas and flight connections.
WhataHotel notes the city's luxury scene is still developing, so outside dining, shopping and entertainment choices may be more limited.
